ruleDefinitions.name: Invoke-Obfuscation Via Use MSHTA
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via use MSHTA in Scripts

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*set.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\&\\&.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*mshta.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*vbscript\\:createobject.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.run.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\(window\\\.close\\).*"))
